_schema_guide.description: Dynamically Defined Local Identifier (LID) Train Composition Schema Guide (ISO 14230-3)

keys.name: Descriptive human-readable name string (e.g., 'engineCore', 'boostAir').
keys.transmission_mode: ISO 14230-3 transmission mode options: 'single' (0x01, daemon polls the ECU on demand at the active poll rate) or 'fast' (0x04, ECU streams periodically). Only these two are supported by the BMWP2000 library; any other value falls back to 'fast'.
keys.cids: Array of CID string keys referenced in sequence order from master cids.json.
